observation.scope: Read-only environment observation before selected core/static checks. No full socket/timing regression or product acceptance conclusion.

implementation.io_basis: WSS owns socket halves, queues and registration until their destruction before the resource witness. Quinn 0.11.12 buffered_transmit is not cleared by the public close call; QUIC closes API resources immediately then requires the shared endpoint wait_idle driver witness. Timeout/cancellation retains the original promise.
implementation.exact_retry_basis: Raw claim bytes and signature plus digest match the durable receipt. Immutable signed ACK binds exact request, all identities and acceptance time; no repeated refund/audit. An acknowledged receipt survives same-epoch control restart; new facts cannot bypass the original control-runtime/fence binding. Restore rejects old epochs.
known_limitations: Another active QUIC allocation can prevent the shared endpoint from becoming idle within the fixed drain budget; its predecessor then keeps the original capacity promise. Actual two-pair synthetic-business fixture verifies this behavior.
Node pending receipts are runtime-owned and not replayed after a node process crash; original promise expiry handles unconfirmed closure.
Complete Linux socket/timing regression remains blocked by the previously recorded WSL realtime rollback. Selected core/static checks do not establish full Ubuntu acceptance.
Multi-node/direct scheduling, TURN/edge/tunnels, aggregate budgets, complete apps/IPC/installers/signatures/hardware and company/mobile-network/72-hour/formal acceptance remain open.
